fusions.name: Pellucid
fusions.desc: Strikes the target from up to 7 tiles away: it deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances. The target is left [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Brine in the Lashes
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 drops of brine at once, spread apart. Each one deals 2 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mirror Pond
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Droplet Lens
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and you carry 10% water resistance.
